operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper states type-aware graph convolution/message passing, which is not represented by the catalog's learned projection or attention primitives.
The paper states computation of RotatE triple scores; the catalog has no operation for knowledge-graph scoring or complex-space relational rotation.
